snippet.title: Slow Down (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/slow-down/id993876722

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.slowdown

Control time with the tip of your finger! Just tap the screen to Slow Down.

Avoid all obstacles and collect stars to unlock new balls!

You are in control... But how far can you go?
